name: 100,000 Food Packet
description: A dense food packet containing dry rations. Use to immediately add 100,000 Food to your city storehouse.

name: 100,000 Wood Bundles
description: High-quality lumber prepared for construction. Use to immediately add 100,000 Wood to your city storehouse.

name: 50,000 Stone Blocks
description: Carved heavy granite blocks for structural fortifications. Use to immediately add 50,000 Stone to your city storehouse.

name: 25,000 Deep Iron Ore
description: Smelted metal plates ready for smithing weapons. Use to immediately add 25,000 Iron to your city storehouse.

name: 1,000 Royal Diamonds
description: Precious sparkling diamonds reserved for royal upgrades. Use to immediately receive 1,000 Royal Crystals / Diamonds.

name: 1h Academy Speedup
description: Accelerates active Academy research times by 1 Hour. Can only be applied when an active research task is running.

name: 1h Builder's Guild Blueprint
description: Coordinates builder shifts, speeding up active construction upgrades by 1 Hour.

name: 5m Chrono Hourglass
description: A micro hourglass that speeds up any active construction, research, or troop training task by 5 Minutes.

name: Large XP Elixir
description: Brewed from Stardust Herbs, this glowing potion instantly grants +5,000 experience points to the selected Hero.

name: Sovereign Oath Shard
description: A fragment of an ancient commander's statue. Collect 50 shards to summon the Legendary Lord Aurelius.

name: Recruit's Broadsword
description: A standardized steel blade given to newly appointed lieutenants. Grants +2.5% Infantry Attack.

name: Recruit's Iron Visor
description: A heavy metal helmet that covers the face. Grants +2.0% Marching Defense.

name: Stardust Crystal Shard
description: A brilliant gem extracted from meteor remnants. Highly coveted by the Blacksmith for forging level 20+ Epic gear.

name: Golden Imperial Chest
description: An ornate royal chest containing high-rarity commander artifacts. Open to see what riches lie inside!
